column1: # npm manifest counters (package.json), for a rule with the prompt file-body-ops: one per line, label
# TAB pattern (Java regex). JSON has no comments, so nothing is blanked. An entry of an object or a
# list counts where it stands: the first one after the key's { or [, then each one after a comma that
# directly follows the last (\G), so the count stops at the object's } and an entry after it does not
# count; a key of that name in another object counts as well (rare in a package.json). "scripts", the
# dependency objects and "engines" count their "name": "value" entries,
# "workspaces" the strings of its list. A VS Code extension's manifest counts its contributed
# commands (a "command" directly followed by its "title", which a menu entry has not) and its
# language model tools (each one's required "modelDescription"). OpsFactPatternsTest pins every case;
# ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every pattern reads linearly.
